title: GovernedRecord
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.GovernedRecord). Compliance-side METADATA about a record another service owns - source_reference is an opaque pointer back to that service's own object (e.g. 'membership-service:membership:<uuid>'). This service never holds the record's content and deliberately has no field that could carry it. state is never 'destroyed' without destruction_evidence_id, and a record is never removed: destruction leaves this row in place with its evidence reference attached (PACK-09 required invariant 4). No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
